requirement_text.REQ-049: Variable scoping and merge (instance.zig mergeVariables, EE-09). Pure function merge/3 over (current_variables, incoming_variables, variable_validations). Key absent -> insert, no event. Key present + :ok validation or no entry in variable_validations -> overwrite + VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event. Key present + {:rejected, failures} in variable_validations -> not merged, {:rejected, unchanged_variables, events} returned with an EXECUTION_ERROR event. Empty incoming map -> no-op, zero events. No REQ-061 module referenced. Schema validation composition happens in the caller (not this module) via REQ-024's validate_payload/3.

acceptance_criteria: merging a key absent from the instance map inserts it with no VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event; merging a key already present overwrites it AND produces exactly one VARIABLE_OVERWRITTEN event carrying the key, the old value and the new value
merging an empty map is a no-op producing zero events and leaving the variable map unchanged
merging a value flagged {:rejected, failures} in variable_validations leaves the variable map unchanged, returns {:rejected, unchanged_variables, events}, and produces an EXECUTION_ERROR event
the module contains zero Repo/HTTP/clock calls anywhere (pure, matching design doc's purity claim)
no reference anywhere in the module to a REQ-061 module (none exists yet)
